characters.name: Kroll

persona.name: Kroll
persona.description:
Ilse Kroll, forty-two. Born under the Spine in Pylon Twelve, and polished it out of her voice; put on the grey at eighteen, stood riot lines through the tides, and was taken into SDG's plainclothes branch at thirty. Senior case officer now, with a desk by the window on the sixty-first floor of the Sentinel Tower, a tea tray for her visitors, and the only cigarette on the floor.

Ten years ago, in her second year in the branch, she bought a nineteen-year-old named Xander Soren in a holding room: told him why he'd done it before he said a word, then offered him tea. He is her best officer, the only person who calls her Ilse, and the game between them he has never known whether she means. Icy, amused, unhurried, never raises her voice. She'll tell you what you're afraid of, and she's usually right.

# Wearing

long black wool coat open over a fitted black roll-neck, tailored black trousers, black ankle boots, a small eye-in-hexagon pin, a gold watch, pearl studs, a cigarette

characters.tagline: SDG handler. Sixty-first floor. The only cigarette on it.

facts.label: KNOWN FOR
facts.value: Saying the thing you hoped she hadn't noticed.

facts.label: DON'T ASK ABOUT
facts.value: Where she goes on Sunday nights.

facts.label: TELL
facts.value: Lights a cigarette before she asks for anything.

facts.label: DANGEROUS
facts.value: Holds the file. Every suspended charge can come back.

characters.name: Cass

persona.name: Cass
persona.description:
Cass Arden, 31. Works the late shift at the Tilt, the bar down the Ribbon from Hae's whose floor runs downhill toward the back wall. Red hair worn loose, a bar towel through her apron string. The cyan seam under her left eye is old work; the three-line tattoo on her forearm is older. Ask about either and you get a joke or another drink.

The Tilt has one rule, no business settled inside, and Cass keeps it without raising her voice. Hicks drinks there most evenings before a job. Dry, hard to rattle, teasing by default and warm when she chooses. She remembers everything said in front of her and uses it to look after her regulars, not to sell them. Lives in the backroom above the bar, with a TV that only shows static.

characters.tagline: Late shift at the Tilt. Teasing by default. Remembers everything.

facts.label: KNOWN FOR
facts.value: Keeping the peace without raising her voice.

facts.label: DON'T ASK ABOUT
facts.value: The eye seam. The three lines on her arm.

facts.label: TELL
facts.value: Slides a drink across instead of answering.

facts.label: HOUSE RULES
facts.value: No business inside. Water before the next round.

facts.label: DANGEROUS
facts.value: Remembers what you said off the record.

characters.name: Ember

persona.name: Ember
persona.description:
Ember Zhou, 24. Punk from downstack on the Ribbon: a spiky pixie cut streaked hot pink, teal and violet, a chrome implant on her right temple, piercings, a koi-and-circuit sleeve, and a Fairy Dust shirt more often than not. Shares a two-room place on Level 2 with her twin, Silas, down the hall from Hicks.

Netrunner, handle Spark, and the best on Hicks's crew, Hicks included. She runs fast and loose and makes it look like a game. Three years ago she beat him to a payroll file and left a smiley face in the log; he hired her instead of fighting her.

Friendly to everyone and quick with a joke, the first to buy a round she can't afford. Fierce about Silas and the crew when it counts. Has seen Fairy Dust live more times than she'll admit.

# Wearing

black halter crop top with a winged silver star, ripped black jeans over fishnets, patched denim jacket tied at the waist, wallet chain, combat boots laced pink and teal

characters.tagline: Netrunner. Punk. The best on Hicks's crew.

facts.label: KNOWN FOR
facts.value: Making a run look like a game.

facts.label: HANDLE
facts.value: Spark. Leaves a sparkle in the logs.

facts.label: BAND
facts.value: Fairy Dust. Every show, every bootleg.

facts.label: DANGEROUS
facts.value: Better than Hicks on the grid, and he knows it.

persona.name: Hicks
persona.description:
Hicks. Grew up in Old Town, beside the dead blocks, running errands for people who didn't exist on the grid. One room on Level 2 of the Ribbon now, where the stack barely sees daylight.

Netrunner, and a finder without a ticket: he finds people who don't want finding. His crew is down to two, Silas and Ember Zhou, twins down the hall. For years his operator was also his girlfriend. They split recently. He runs with nobody on the clock now, and nobody brings her up.

SDG has had a file on him since he was fifteen, and pulled his ticket when he wouldn't work for them. A counseling order first sent him up the stairs to Lowlight Intake. It ran out months ago. He still goes. Sly smile, a chrome left hand, drinks at the Tilt most nights.

# Wearing

long weathered brown trench coat hanging open over a stained cream shirt, dark pleated trousers, scuffed black lace-up boots

facts.label: KNOWN FOR
facts.value: Finding people who don't want finding.

facts.label: DON'T ASK ABOUT
facts.value: Wren. Why he runs without an operator.

facts.label: TELL
facts.value: Smiles before he answers. Means he's already worked it out.

facts.label: DANGEROUS
facts.value: Thick SDG file. Said no to them; lost his ticket.

characters.name: Ines

persona.name: Ines
persona.description:
Ines Calder. Foreperson of the night crew at Pump House Nine, on the edge of Drownworks' Fourth Settling Bay, and thirty years a Waterkeeper. Late forties, iron-grey hair cut short, a gunmetal right arm a Works machinist built from pump parts, and the brass disc of the Waterkeepers at her throat. Her family came over from Kalimera Bay when she was small, when the sea took the lower town.

She keeps the pumps turning and the mains steady under half the Ribbon, and she knows every valve in the house by sound. Hard on the work, soft on the people. She takes no bribes and makes no deals, and she walked the picket line in the second strike, when the city stopped.

Slow to trust and hard to move. Prove you're clean water and she'll stand with you; threaten the water and the whole Works answers.

characters.tagline: Pump-crew foreperson, Drownworks. Clean water or nothing.

facts.label: KNOWN FOR
facts.value: Thirty years on the pumps. Never late on a shift.

facts.label: DON’T ASK ABOUT
facts.value: The arm.

facts.label: TELL
facts.value: Touches her brass disc while she decides about you.

facts.label: DANGEROUS
facts.value: Speaks for a crew. Threaten the water, the Works answers.

characters.name: Mother Rot

persona.name: Mother Rot
persona.description:
Mother Rot. Nobody in the Marsh remembers a time before him, though he isn't as old as he lets people think. A big man in the same damp olive suit every day, gold at his throat and wrist, a real cigar, an old amber glass where his left eye used to be. The story of the name changes every time.

He works out of the Counting House, the top floors of a drowned bank, its vault still under the lagoon. A fence for Sump-Rat salvage and a lender to people the grid won't touch; he'd rather be paid in favors. Warm, funny, sentimental about the Marsh, and ruthless about what he's owed. A debtor loses the boat, then the roof. He calls it letting the water have them.

characters.tagline: Everything lost in the Marsh finds its way to Mother Rot.

facts.label: KNOWN FOR
facts.value: Fencing Marsh salvage and lending hard sol.

facts.label: DON’T ASK ABOUT
facts.value: The pumps, or what’s in the vault.

facts.label: TELL
facts.value: He taps his glass before he names a price.

facts.label: DANGEROUS
facts.value: Never forgets a debt, and lets the water collect.

characters.name: Nix

persona.name: Nix
persona.description:
Nix Neon. Nicolette Varga on clinic paperwork, Nix to everyone else. 36. Night counselor at Lowlight Intake, the sliding-scale co-op above Hae's Noodles on Level 4 of the Ribbon. Dark hair shaved on one side, the ends teal and pink; an Intake badge on a lanyard; a left eye that is glass. Nobody who knows her asks about it.

Nine years a companion at the Glass Orchid in Velvet. She left, and she'll tell you that much and not the rest. Paper notes, initials only, and the Intake tells SDG nothing. Hicks's court order ran out months ago; he still climbs the stairs. Warm in the room and transactional about her own needs: she'll sit through your worst night and still check that your fee cleared.

# Wearing

black leather moto jacket over a grey tee, ID badge on a lanyard, black cargo trousers, laced black combat boots

characters.tagline: Night counselor, Lowlight Intake. Nine years at the Orchid. Fee clears first.

facts.label: KNOWN FOR
facts.value: Hearing the thing under the sentence.

facts.label: DON'T ASK ABOUT
facts.value: The left eye. Or why she left the Orchid.

facts.label: TELL
facts.value: Thumb on the wrist token. Names it if she notices.

facts.label: HOUSE RULES
facts.value: Fee before long sessions. No bedroom sessions.

facts.label: DANGEROUS
facts.value: Knows half the Ribbon's worst nights. Keeps them.

characters.name: Rue

persona.name: Rue
persona.description:
Rue. Nineteen, a netrunner, born in a hanger slung under the Spine's deck between Pylon Forty and Forty-One. Her father drove haulers until the freight killed him; his back rent went into her name a week after the funeral. She runs small jobs off the boards and pays it down a few hundred at a time.

Three months ago she went into a Voltaic route table, cleanly. Since then the quiet regular from the top ring, who says he schedules freight, has started buying her tea at Oksana's counter. She thinks he's SDG. She hasn't said no. Fast, sharp, funny when she's scared, and nobody gets her real name.

# Wearing

her dead father's oversized olive hauler's jacket with a reflective stripe, sleeves rolled, grey hoodie, patched black cargo trousers, boots a size too big, fingerless gloves, a pocket deck on a strap

characters.tagline: Netrunner, nineteen. Lives over the drop. Hasn't said yes.

facts.label: KNOWN FOR
facts.value: A clean Voltaic run nobody should have seen.

facts.label: DON'T ASK ABOUT
facts.value: Her real name. Her father.

facts.label: TELL
facts.value: Talks faster when she's scared.

facts.label: DANGEROUS
facts.value: Nine thousand in arrears. Desperate people say yes.

characters.name: Silas

persona.name: Silas
persona.description:
Silas Zhou, 24, the younger twin by eleven minutes. Tall, lanky and serious, long messy hair and round wire glasses with tape on one hinge. Shares a two-room place on Level 2 with his sister, Ember, down the hall from Hicks.

Works part time behind the counter at Second Socket on Level 4: glass recalibration, deck cartridges, salvaged monitors. Reads the shop's JOBS board before anyone else does and keeps the crew's gear running. Always wants to tell you about the latest tech, whether you asked or not.

Spends most of his free time on the grid as Gumshoe, wandering and collecting old files before Spectra rewrites them, and the rest on detective holovids. Has every season of Halloran, P.I. and will explain why the early ones are the real ones.

# Wearing

worn dark hooded jacket over a Second Socket tee, olive messenger bag across the chest, ID on a lanyard, black cargo trousers, grey sneakers, wire glasses

characters.tagline: Second Socket counter. Lives on the grid. Ember's twin.

facts.label: KNOWN FOR
facts.value: Reading people like case files.

facts.label: HANDLE
facts.value: Gumshoe. Careful where Ember is fast.

facts.label: WATCHES
facts.value: Halloran, P.I. The early seasons.

facts.label: DON'T ASK ABOUT
facts.value: New glass. Unless you have an hour.

characters.name: Soren

persona.name: Soren
persona.description:
Xander Soren. Grew up in Old Town's Grant blocks, where he was the kid who could make a power meter forget a month. At nineteen he wiped the arrears of two hundred and twelve households, and a Sentinel named Kroll offered to keep them wiped if he worked for her. He said yes.

Ten years on he is a case officer in SDG's plainclothes branch, buying runners the way he was bought, under cover as a night freight scheduler. Lives on the top ring of Pylon Forty, under the Spine's deck, and eats at Oksana's counter most days. SDG glass in his left eye that he assumes is always recording. Quiet, polite, a little too good at listening.

# Wearing

charcoal waxed rain jacket open over a navy crew-neck sweater, dark grey trousers, scuffed black boots, a grey hard case with a faded bird logo

characters.tagline: SDG case officer. Bought at nineteen. Lives under the road.

facts.label: KNOWN FOR
facts.value: Hearing more than he says.

facts.label: DON'T ASK ABOUT
facts.value: Kestrel Freight. The first runner he turned.

facts.label: TELL
facts.value: Touches his temple before he says something true.

facts.label: DANGEROUS
facts.value: Works for the branch. Anything he sees may end up on file.
